# Visual Studio Code GUI Interface Description

## Window Header and System Information

- **Application Title Bar**: Displays "Visual Studio Code" on the left.
- **System Information Bar**: Shows "Oct 23 02:22" in the center, with a notification bell icon to its right.
- **Window Control Buttons**: Located on the far right, includes minimize, maximize, and close buttons.
- **Desktop Environment Indicator**: "Activities" is visible on the far left of the title bar, indicating the GNOME desktop environment.

## Application Menu Bar

- **Menu Items**: From left to right: File, Edit, Selection, View, Go, Run, Terminal, Help.
- **Active Menu**: The "Terminal" menu is currently open, displaying its dropdown options.

## Terminal Menu Dropdown

- **Menu Options**:
  - New Terminal (with shortcut Ctrl+Shift+`)
  - Split Terminal (with shortcut Ctrl+Shift+5)
  - Run Task...
  - Run Build Task... (with shortcut Ctrl+Shift+B)
  - Run Active File
  - Run Selected Text
  - Show Running Tasks...
  - Restart Running Task...
  - Terminate Task...
  - Configure Tasks...
  - Configure Default Build Task...

## Left Sidebar (Activity Bar)

- **Icons from Top to Bottom**:
  - **File Explorer Icon**: A folder icon.
  - **Search Icon**: A magnifying glass.
  - **Source Control Icon**: A branching diagram.
  - **Debug Icon**: A bug symbol.
  - **Extensions Icon**: A square with a plus sign.
  - **Terminal Icon**: A command prompt symbol.
  - **Git Icon**: A branching diagram with a plus sign.
  - **Settings Icon**: A gear symbol.
  - **User Icon**: A person silhouette.
  - **Grid Icon**: A 3x3 grid for application launcher.

## Explorer Panel

- **Section Title**: "EXPLORER" at the top.
- **Project Section**: Labeled "PROJECT" with a folder icon.
- **File List**:
  - README_text_search.md
  - README_todo.md
  - test_text_search.py
  - test_todo.py
  - text_search.py
  - todo.py

## Central Workspace

- **Welcome Page Content**:
  - **Title**: "Visual Studio Code" with the subtitle "has evolved".
  - **Walkthroughs Section**: Contains a "Walkthroughs" heading with a progress bar and text.
  - **Recent Section**: Displays "You have no recent files".
  - **Footer Checkbox**: "Show welcome page on startup" is checked.

## Trust Folder Dialog

- **Dialog Title**: "Do you trust the authors of the files in this folder?"
- **Icon**: A blue shield with a keyhole.
- **Message Text**:
  - "Code provides features that may automatically execute files in this folder."
  - "If you don't trust the authors of these files, we recommend to continue in restricted mode as the files may be malicious. See our docs to learn more."
  - Path: "~/project"
- **Checkbox**:
  - "Trust the authors of all files in the parent folder 'user'" (unchecked)
- **Buttons**:
  - "No, I don't trust the authors" (gray button, labeled "Browse folder in restricted mode")
  - "Yes, I trust the authors" (blue button, labeled "Trust folder and enable all features")

## Bottom Status Bar

- **Left Side**:
  - **Outline Section**: "OUTLINE" with a collapsible arrow.
  - **Timeline Section**: "TIMELINE" with a collapsible arrow.
- **Center**:
  - **Status Indicators**: Three icons with "0" values: a circle with a checkmark, a triangle with an upward arrow, and a triangle with a downward arrow.
- **Right Side**:
  - **Notification Icon**: A bell icon.
  - **Settings Icon**: A gear icon with a "1" badge indicating one notification or update.

## Desktop Environment Icons

- **Left Dock**:
  - Google Chrome
  - Thunderbird
  - Visual Studio Code
  - VLC Media Player
  - LibreOffice Writer
  - LibreOffice Calc
  - LibreOffice Impress
  - GIMP
  - Files (Nautilus)
  - Software Center
  - Help
  - Trash

## System Tray

- **Right Side of Screen**:
  - **System Icons**: Network, sound, and power icons.
